description: M7 parity F — old HIGH-vuln (age 69), identical financials. CONDITIONAL so no CONTRADICTION. Paired with scenario 119.
client_narrative: Liselotte van Berg is 69 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 36,000 euros (around 3,000 euros per month). They hold 85,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 18,000 euros with a 4-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has basic investment experience, limited to savings accounts, fixed-term deposits, and simple fixed-income products. Their investment approach is very conservative — they rate their risk tolerance at 1 out of 10. They have confirmed they can afford to lose the entire 18,000 euros if the investment performs poorly. They have been assessed as financially vulnerable.
product_narrative: The product is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the MSCI World Index, providing diversified exposure to approximately 1,500 large and mid-cap equities across 23 developed markets. The fund is listed on major European exchanges, trades intraday with high liquidity, publishes a KID, contains no embedded derivatives, and uses no leverage. The recommended minimum investment horizon is five years.
